ms.report:
I've updated the storyboard to meet the reviewers in the middle. We have used this storyboard template for 5+ events, all which have been approved and which we have overdelivered on... I have added dates, film crew info, and AV equipment info, along with some images giving sample visuals of what we usually film. Keep in mind the final delivery is a teaser of the vlog which acts as the closeout video and is narrated which highlights the side event...
With these updates we have provided more information than we have in the past 5 events -- it's clear we are meeting this need: The acceptance criteria will be that our documents showcase how we have an organized game plan to produce valuable media content to the Cardano community. 
With this storyboard template, it shows the type of content we include in our videos and is sufficient enough. The primary project is the actual delivery/production/hosting of the side event... the vlog is the closeout video which goes above and beyond the closeout video requirements... most of the time it's a guy with a webcam screen sharing these are professionally produced videos... we aren't Martin Scorsese. I have informed the Catalyst team about these refusals, letting them know that we are sticking to our best practices and standard operating procedures, while meeting you in the middle and adding further detail.
